questions.q: To whom does the elder address this letter?
options: The chosen lady and her children

questions.q: How does the elder describe the many deceivers who have gone out into the world?
options: They don't confess Jesus Christ came in the flesh
They teach that the law must be kept
They deny the resurrection of the dead
They falsely claim to be apostles

questions.q: Why does the elder not want to write more with paper and ink?
options: He hopes to come and speak face to face
He fears the letter will be intercepted
He has already sent a messenger
He is too weak to keep writing

questions.q: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children ____.
Not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, ____.
He who remains in the teaching has ____.
questions.answer: both the Father and the Son

questions.q: The elder tells the lady to welcome into her house anyone who comes, even if he doesn't bring this teaching.
The letter closes with greetings from the children of the lady's chosen sister.
What does the elder say love is?
What does the elder say remains in us and will be with us forever?
The greeting says grace, mercy, and peace will be with us in what?
Watch yourselves, that we don't lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive ____.
This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that ____.
The greeting says grace, mercy, and peace come from both God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
